Question
========
What is the primary purpose of a Data Management Plan (DMP)?

Answerlist
----------
* To submit with one's research proposal
* To describe how data will be handled throughout its lifecycle
* To eliminate bureaucracy within the organization
* To describe how data should contribute to the organization's goals


Solution
========
The primary purpose of a Data Management Plan is to describe how data will be handled throughout its lifecycle.

Answerlist
----------
* False
* True
* False
* False
